reason: I'm home with the kids all week and always need somewhere new to go, so I'd use the free visit and probably pay for a couple more drop-ins. Clean and not packed matters to me.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, so it only works for me if the per-visit price stays low and it's worth the drive from Fruitland.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-child weekday price, or a pack that doesn't push me to commit to more visits than I'd really use.
